title: compare_inventory_list input
description: The fallback for routes B and C and for estates the server cannot read itself. The admin's own tool fetches the list as the admin and passes it in. The product compares and writes claims. It cannot prove the list came from Microsoft, so the run is marked evidence level as reported. Vanished claims are raised only when isFinalPage is true.

gapCheckRunId.description: Continue this run with another page.

estateKey.description: The estate, from the estate value list.

externalId.description: The item's ID in its own tool.

sourceType.description: The source type as the tool names it.

labelAsSeen.description: The item's name in its tool.

url.description: A link that opens the item in its tool, when the list gives one. Stored on the claim (O23 Url) and on the component a claim creates.

items.description: The inventory items, up to 1000 per call.

sourceNote.description: Where the list came from, in plain words.

isFinalPage.description: True when this call carries the last page of every covered estate. Only then are vanished claims raised.

examples.sourceNote: Exported with the admin CLI on 22 November.
